messages:
Maya: Quick note from the design huddle: we need a tight spec for resume+ack across languages before the RFC lands.
Ibrahim: Agreed. Main constraint: keep default simple for adopters. PAGE semantics by default, ITEM opt-in.
Jun: One feel we didn't fully decide on where to persist last-acked token for ITEM flows. Proposal: SDKs provide a pluggable persister interface (file/sqlite/memory) with a default of ephemeral memory and an opt-in durable impl.
Rita: That sounds good. Also call out the semantics: durable persister -> at-least-once with minimal dupes; ephemeral -> possible duplicates after crash. Document clearly.
Maya: Transport capability discovery: each service should expose a capability object (e.g., resumability: [PAGE, ITEM], transports: [http,poll,grpc,ws]). SDKs query this on init and pick the best supported mapping.
Ibrahim: Retry rules:
- For PAGE: safe to retry GETs; apply exponential backoff.
- For ITEM: on reconnect, client sends last_acked_token; server resumes after that. If server no longer has state, return RESUME_EXPIRED error and client falls back to fresh listing.
Jun: Language shapes:
- Python: `for page in client.list_pages():` and `for item, ack in client.stream_items():` (ack is coroutine)
- TS: async iterable of `{ item, ack }` where ack is a Promise-returning fn
- Go: `chan StreamMsg{Item, Ack func() error}` plus context cancellation
Maya: Observability: SDKs should emit metrics: resumed_sessions, resume_failures, ack_latency_ms, duplicate_deliveries_count. We should wire these to the Console defaults.
Rita: Security note: ack endpoints must enforce auth and rate-limit; also log ack attempts for audit.
infra-bot: noted: create issue INFRA-2145 to add capability flags to runtime metadata
Ibrahim: Action items: Maya write the mini-spec (1 pager) covering capability discovery, default PAGE behavior, opt-in ITEM shapes and persistence options. Jun: sample persister impls for py/ts/go. Rita: telemetry/metrics list for Console.
Maya: I'll drop the 1-pager in the RFC repo and ping.
Jun: No objections from me.
Rita: +1
Maya: closing thread.
